tasks.short: Set out and recover stakes, marks or monumentation.

steps.what: Read which stakes and marks the job names.
Set out and recover stakes, marks or monumentation.
Log the marks set or recovered.

tasks.design: The point list is on {PROJECT}. Setting out and recovering stakes, marks and monumentation stays in the field. {OPS_SYSTEM} only logs what the technician found or set. A missing mark is not filled in by a coordinate.
tasks.previous_blocker: The list was a paper sheet, and a recovered mark lived in a notebook.
tasks.enabler_now: A point id and a found-or-missing flag are fields. Finding the mark in the ground is not.
tasks.still_hard: A mark that has been moved, buried or lost stays a search.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can tell a real monument from a piece of iron that happens to be nearby.
tasks.altitude: The log takes less rewriting. The field work stays. Nothing is marked found that was not in the hand.

evidence.claim: A point log with an id and a found flag is a record. Setting a stake is not.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician sets and recovers marks. Searching for a corner that is not on the list is a different task. The party chief owns the survey.
Structured input: point id, type (stake, mark, monument), coordinates if already computed. Producer is the point list. A log row needs the point id and what was found.
Field time stays. The log does not invent a recovery.
unknowns: Who may say a monument is the original?
research_questions: How often is a recovery written up only back at the office?

already_counted.description: Setting and recovering marks is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire point rows for jobs that closed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If there is no point list, the technician still works from the chief's instruction and types the log later. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Search for section corners, property irons or survey points.

steps.what: Search for section corners, property irons or points.
Decide whether the found iron is the corner.
Record the survey point as found or not found.

tasks.design: The search stays on the ground. The technician decides whether an iron is the corner, using the deed and the old points. {OPS_SYSTEM} records found or not found only after that decision. A coordinate is a place to look, not a corner.
tasks.previous_blocker: Searches were remembered, and a later crew dug in the same wrong place.
tasks.enabler_now: Found or not found is a field. Recognising the corner is not.
tasks.still_hard: A corner with no remaining iron, or two irons close together, stays a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The technician has dug this kind of corner before and knows the usual miss.
tasks.altitude: The record of the search is kept. The search and the decision stay.

reach.task: Accept or reject the corner call

evidence.claim: Recording found or not found is a form. A search does not become shorter because the form exists.
Calling a property corner can affect a boundary. The source pack does not name the cadastral statute. The record is the technician's note, not a title determination.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician searches and notes. The party chief or a licensed surveyor determines the boundary. This task does not certify title.
Structured input: point id, what was found, photo, decision. Producer is the technician on the search. A record with no point id is refused.
Search time stays. The record does not move a boundary.
unknowns: Who may call an iron the section corner?
Are old points in the same store?
research_questions: How often is a corner searched for twice?

already_counted.description: The search is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire search notes for jobs that closed.

approvals.approved_version: corner decision the technician made on that search

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If old points are only on paper, the search is unchanged and the record is typed once. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate latitudes, longitudes, angles and areas.

steps.what: Load survey field notes that are already rows.
Calculate latitudes, longitudes, angles and areas.
Check a result the closure test did not pass.

tasks.design: Field notes that are already rows, and the reference table, feed a calculation of latitudes, longitudes, angles and areas on {DATA_PLATFORM}. A closure that fails is not written through. The technician checks that result. Mapmaking uses the accepted figures. Notes that are still a sketch are not calculated.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same traverse was computed by hand, and a transcription error showed up late.
tasks.enabler_now: Angles and distances in rows, and a closure tolerance, are arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: A note that does not balance, or a reference table for the wrong zone, stays a check.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which leg was mis-booked, which a residual only hints at.
tasks.altitude: The arithmetic takes less time. The check of a failed closure stays. A sketch is not treated as rows.

reach.task: Use only accepted latitudes and areas

evidence.claim: Latitudes, areas and a closure from booked angles are a calculation. The source pack names survey software that adjusts a traverse. This is the pattern, not a measured case here.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician calculates from booked notes. Collecting the notes is a different task. A licensed boundary opinion is not a coordinate.
Structured input: point id, angle, distance, reference-table id. Producer is the field log. A missing distance stops the calculation for that leg.
Checking a failed closure is remaining time. No figure is invented to force a close.
research_questions: How often does a hand calculation fail to close?

already_counted.description: Checking a failed closure is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire results computed on a withdrawn table.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the notes are sketches, nothing is calculated until they are booked, and the check stays. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enter deeds, notes and positioning data for map drawings.

steps.what: Load positioning data the collector already stored.
Read legal deeds, field notes and survey reports.
Decide which points may enter the map drawings.
Enter the accepted points for the graphic drawings.

tasks.design: Positioning data already on the collector loads into {DATA_PLATFORM}. Deeds, field notes and survey reports stay a reading. The technician decides which points may become map drawings. {OPS_SYSTEM} enters only that set. A deed is not parsed into a boundary.
tasks.previous_blocker: Points, deeds and notes were typed again into the map workstation.
tasks.enabler_now: A collector file with point ids can load. A deed's meaning cannot.
tasks.still_hard: A deed that disagrees with the points stays a reading.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows which call in the deed the point does not match.
tasks.altitude: Reloading the collector file takes less time. Reading the deed and deciding the drawing stay.

reach.task: See the points that were not entered
reach.learn: Which deed call was in conflict

evidence.claim: Loading a collector file is a copy. Turning a deed into a boundary drawing is not.
A deed is a legal document. The source pack does not name the land-registry rule. Entering points does not determine ownership.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the technician enters accepted points. Interpreting a dispute is the surveyor. Drawing the finished sheet is a later task.
Structured input: point id, northing, easting, height, deed id. Producer is the collector for the point and the technician for the acceptance. A point with no id is not entered.
Deed reading stays. The map does not gain a line the technician rejected.
unknowns: Does the collector file use the same point ids as the deeds?
Who may override a deed conflict?
research_questions: How often is a point typed twice, once from the collector and once from the note?

already_counted.description: Reading the deeds and notes is already the remaining time on that step.

incremental.description: Retire entered points when the survey is superseded.

approvals.approved_version: accepted set the technician decided for that survey

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If deeds are unscanned, the load of points still works and the reading stays on paper. Provisional.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Staking, searching and operating the instrument stay outdoors. A coordinate does not count as a found corner. Calculations run only on booked rows, and a failed closure is checked. Deeds are read, not parsed into title.
reach: The party chief sees found, missing and rejected points.
Map drawings contain only the accepted set.
skills_to_grow: Record not-found rather than a guessed corner.
Stop a calculation that does not close.
role.ambitious_version: A recovered mark has a log the same day, and a deed conflict is visible before the point is drawn.
